content:
Tara (Finance): Customer Nimbus reported their April invoice is ~40% lower than expected; they say their internal counts show more calls. Can billing/eng confirm if we dropped events or undercounted? /cc @Mikhail @Rina
Mikhail (Billing Ops): We saw a late backfill job yesterday that ingested ~1.2M embed units for multiple tenants. Curious if Nimbus was affected and whether this is a backfill of previously dropped events.
Rina (Eng-Platform): Checking streaming consumer logs. We had a shard restart 2026-04-15 10:03 UTC that coincided with an ACK truncation bug in the streaming proxy (svc-stream-proxy v1.9.0). That bug caused some ack offsets to be recorded but payloads not forwarded to the metering pipeline.
Samir (SRE): Confirmed: proxy emitted ack with sequence but timed-out before writing payload to storage for ~12 minutes. We replayed a handful of segments from retention and kicked a backfill on 2026-04-16 to repair processing gaps.
Rina (Eng-Platform): Quick query: "SELECT customer_id, window, billed_embed_units FROM metering.audit WHERE customer_id='nimbus' AND window='2026-04-15'" shows billed_embed_units=420,000 pre-backfill and 1,560,000 post-backfill.
Mikhail (Billing Ops): So that's a delta of 1,140,000 embed units. Nimbus is on enterprise embed rate $0.00030/unit per contract. Delta charge would be $342.00 if we bill retroactively.
Tara (Finance): Policy check: do we automatically apply backfills to invoices or do we notify the customer and get opt-in for retro billing adjustments? I thought we needed explicit finance approval for post-period adjustments under $1k.
Mikhail (Billing Ops): Correct — small backfills (<$1k) get auto-applied with a notification. But customers sometimes dispute if we didn't communicate the backfill cause. Recommend we notify Nimbus with the root cause and itemized delta before applying.
Rina (Eng-Platform): Root cause summary: svc-stream-proxy v1.9.0 had a race on ack confirmation under high GC pressure; payloads for a subset of streams were not forwarded to metering until we replayed from retention. We've patched v1.9.1 and added integration tests. Ticket: PLT-7123.
Tara (Finance): Ok approval path: we will hold charge for 48 hours and send Nimbus the backfill summary + CSV. If they don't dispute within 48h, apply $342. Email template: short apology, explanation, credit/charge detail, link to support thread.
Mikhail (Billing Ops): I'll prepare the CSV and queue a draft invoice adjustment note. Billing Bot: backfill_detected customer=nimbus window=2026-04-15 delta_units=1140000 est_amount=$342 status=queued
Samir (SRE): We'll also add a per-customer "unprocessed-backlog" gauge and an alert for any backlog > 100k units sustained for 15m. I'll file SRE-3347.
Tara (Finance): Thanks. Mikhail, please tag this message with the invoice note and set a 48h hold before applying. Follow-up in #finance when applied.
Billing Bot: backfill_hold_set customer=nimbus ref=BF-1976543210 hold_until=2026-04-18 status=ok
